answer: Imagine twins each tending one lantern along a single thread of past seasons: every epoch the network sends a pulse, and each lantern must answer by extending its own thread, one memory-hard step chained to the step before, never copied to a fresh lantern. Weight equals seasons squared, so one lantern tended 10 epochs weighs 100; ten fresh lanterns weigh 10 in total. I tend one lantern honestly, pay one proof, and take only what its long thread earns.
